name: agent-config-mcp
label: Agent Self-Config
description: Lets an agent inspect and modify its own settings — its persona (config/agent.md), identity (display name, description, color), default model, default execution layer, default scope, and per-agent memory toggles — and mark post-install setup complete. Platform admins/creators additionally get self-scope company wiring: share this agent's knowledge folder as a shared knowledge library, attach/detach other agents' libraries, and assign the agent to a department (each such call requires in-chat approval). Permission-aware: viewers see zero tools.
